courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 錦屏一級水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「開挖卸荷彈性回復」與「季節調蓄水量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；錦屏一級水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Elastic rebound after excavation" and "Seasonal storage water balance" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Jinping-I Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦強震區高拱壩與岸坡耦合；錦屏一級水壩則以超高雙曲拱壩與深谷環境邊界為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on high arch dam and abutment slopes in seismic terrain; Jinping-I Dam centres on very high double curvature arch dam and canyon boundaries, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「開挖卸荷彈性回復」與「高壩水壓投影」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到錦屏一級水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「壩塊自由收縮」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic rebound after excavation” and “High dam pressure projection”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Jinping-I Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Dam block free contraction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 小灣水壩
history.text: 華能公開介紹記錄小灣六部機組合計四千二百兆瓦，於二〇一〇年八月全部建成投產，並將高邊坡、卸荷與溫控列為工程難題。課程保留這些可核對的背景，但不把三百米級描述當成精確壩高。教學中的彈簧、岩楔及水量模型只分離一項機制，沒有重建業主三維分析或地震輸入。監測文獻出版與教材覆核各自標示，避免把網站文章更新日期誤認為水電站投產日。
history.textEn: Huaneng records six Xiaowan units totaling 4200 MW, all operating in August 2010, and identifies slopes, excavation unloading and temperature control as engineering challenges. The course retains those documented facts without interpreting a three-hundred-metre class description as an exact height. Spring, rock-wedge and water-balance examples isolate mechanisms rather than reproduce the owner three-dimensional model or earthquake inputs. Reference publication and curriculum review are dated separately from commissioning and from website article updates.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「開挖卸荷彈性回復」到「岸坡位移速率」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Elastic rebound after excavation" through "Abutment slope movement rate" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
